originality.rationale: The earlier square-zero B_2(R) result already supplies class-size and ordinary character-degree spectra of the affine direct factor, so those facts are explicitly credited and not claimed as the new contribution. The new statement is a complete group-element order census for all odd-residue-characteristic square-zero local rings, with a characteristic-p versus characteristic-p-squared discontinuity that the two old multisets cannot determine. Actual published-finding corpus and literature comparisons found no stronger statement calculating that full distribution. General semidirect-product order results remain an explicit priority risk.
residual_risks: General elementary semidirect-product exponent or power-count results may imply this polynomial without using the same terminology
